subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: After the duplicate lifecycle path is removed, should cron `deferred` be a terminal public handoff status, a nonterminal waiting state, or an internal-only lifecycle state?
rationale: This choice changes persisted run history, Gateway protocol, CLI exit behavior, plugin SDK and hook types, QA tooling, documentation, and Control UI behavior; the intended permanent compatibility contract cannot be inferred safely from the underlying bug alone.

options.title: Public terminal handoff
options.body: Define `deferred` as a completed parent handoff whose descendants continue independently, then align all consumers and prove fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Nonterminal waiting state
options.body: Keep the cron and task run active until descendant settlement wakes the parent and final synthesis completes.

options.title: Internal-only lifecycle
options.body: Preserve the existing public cron status union and represent yielded waiting only in internal runtime state.

recommendation.title: Public terminal handoff
recommendation.body: Define `deferred` as a completed parent handoff whose descendants continue independently, then align all consumers and prove fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history spans the public cron status/protocol and Discord progress surfaces where the permanent cross-product contract must be selected.
